about_the_game:
This is a DLC that allows you to enjoy 4 additional civilizations in 4X4 PROGRESS!
Enjoy the atmosphere and game style of the newly added civilizations, and progress from the Stone Age to the Modern Era once again.

Includes 4 new civilizations.

  • Greece: A civilization that summons gods and gains powerful buffs by collecting Faith, a unique resource of Greece. Unique tiles include the Acropolis and Amphitheater.
  • Shona: A civilization that expands the use of stone resources, builds buildings with stone, and fights against raids. Unique tiles include Great Zimbabwe and Shona Pieces.
  • France: A beautiful civilization with abundant resources. However, human rights for human resources must be guaranteed! Unique tiles include the Chateau and the Eiffel Tower.
  • Hawaii: A challenging civilization that develops a small but beautiful island dominated by the ocean. Unique tiles include canoes and beach resorts.
